caveats: Experimental; requires Paseo >= 0.9.2 and a separately installed official DSH (dsh on PATH).
Self-provisions ~/.dsh/profiles/paseo on first load; set your model route in that profile's cordis.patch.yml.
A vision route must declare an image input modality, or images arrive as a text placeholder.
Plugins and DSH tools are trusted, unsandboxed code, run on the daemon host.
Native direct provider (not ACP): question cards, plan mode, thinking levels, steering, images, slash menu.
